chapter: Forming the band in New York
title: New York hires: Logan, Hogan, Bobby Smith, Kirkland
summary: He recalls Danny Logan, Ray Hogan, Bobby Smith and LeRoy Kirkland and what they wrote.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, how about Danny Logan. Danny Logan joined me in New York. He used to play with some of the big name bands there. Ray Hogan,
also, I think he was with Andy Kirk a year before he joined me. He was, they were both two fine trombone players.

Bobby Smith. He, I don't know if you remember a band called Sunset Royal Entertainers around New York. When they broke up, Bobby Smith, I brought him in as my first alto player. He also was the writer of "Tippin In", one of my, one of my big tunes.

LeRoy Kirkland, the guitar. He did a lot of writing for me. He was with the old Sunset Royal band too. So, William McLamore was playing guitar with me when he first left the school. But, he decided to put it down and he went into a business.
